rule: ships iff pre-Kunark era, or Tier M evidence places it in the game

era-unplaced.title: Era unplaced
era-unplaced.line: No source places it in any era. An item nobody can place is treated as unconfirmed rather than assumed classic, so it waits for a patch note or a first-hand sighting to place it. That is a gap in the evidence, not proof the game lacks it — if you are holding one, it belongs in the catalog and the export importer will say so.

velious.title: Scars of Velious
velious.line: It is Scars of Velious content. EverQuest Legends does not have that expansion, so the item is held out of the catalog rather than offered as something you could go and get.

kunark.title: Ruins of Kunark
kunark.line: It is Ruins of Kunark content. EverQuest Legends does not have that expansion, so the item is held out of the catalog rather than offered as something you could go and get.

epic.title: Epic quests
epic.line: It is Epic Quest content, and this server does not have the epic quests. The wiki carries the page because large parts of it are a Project 1999 import describing original EverQuest, not this game.

chardok.title: Chardok revamp
chardok.line: It comes from the Chardok revamp, a later original-EverQuest content patch this server does not have.

fear-hate-revamp.title: Fear/Hate revamp
fear-hate-revamp.line: It comes from the Fear/Hate revamp, a later original-EverQuest content patch this server does not have. Its five armour sets were once mistaken here for EQL planar gear; the only planar set a player has actually confirmed is Shadow Rage, which does ship.

luclin.title: Shadows of Luclin
luclin.line: It is Shadows of Luclin content. EverQuest Legends does not have that expansion, so the item is held out of the catalog rather than offered as something you could go and get.

flagged-not-legends.title: Flagged not-in-Legends
flagged-not-legends.line: The wiki page for it is itself flagged as not present in EverQuest Legends.
